channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Rangers, Fans React To Artemi Panarin Being Scratched: 'The Situation Is What It Is Now'
item.description: The New York Rangers are reportedly holding Artemi Panarin out of the lineup until the Olympic break for roster reasons. Rangers players, fans and the coach reacted to the reports.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Latest On Senators And MacKenzie Weegar, Bobby McMann And Jeff Skinner
item.description: The Ottawa Senators and Calgary Flames are believed to have had trade discussions about MacKenzie Weeger. Bobby McMann and Jeff Skinner, meanwhile, could be trade candidates.

item.title: The NHL's Battle Of Quebec Returns To Montreal For One Night Between Avalanche And Canadiens
item.description: The Colorado Avalanche wearing Quebec Nordiques uniforms against the Montreal Canadiens at the Bell Centre will serve as a reminder of the province's fierce hockey rivalry that featured gruelling playoff battles.

item.title: Dallas Stars And Vegas Golden Knights Will Face Off In 2027 NHL Stadium Series
item.description: After the NHL previously announced the Dallas Stars would host a 2027 Stadium Series outdoor game, it announced the Vegas Golden Knights as their opponent.

item.title: Avalanche Prospect Goalie Kept Redeeming Himself On His Way To An NHL Call-Up
item.description: Colorado Avalanche prospect Isak Posch wasn't drafted to the NHL and had some challenging years in the USHL and NCAA. Now, he's an AHL rookie headed to the All-Star Classic.

item.title: The Wraparound: Are The Rangers Justified In Holding Artemi Panarin Out Of The Lineup?
item.description: Emma Lingan, Michael Augello and Frank Zawrazky discuss Artemi Panarin being a healthy scratch, the Jets and Leafs' potential trade assets and much more.

item.title: How Long Will Red Wings' Patrick Kane Be The NHL's Highest U.S.-Born Scorer?
item.description: Detroit Red Wings star Patrick Kane is on the cusp of being the highest-scoring U.S.-born player of all-time. If and when he sets the record, it will take a while until Maple Leafs captain Auston Matthews comes close.

item.title: Lightning And Bruins' NHL Stadium Series Will Hope To Find Gold
item.description: With pirate-themed scenery, two red-hot rivals and an ambitious locale for an outdoor game, sail, ho: Sunday's NHL Stadium Series will be unlike any other.

item.title: NHL Hot Seat Radar: Leafs And Kings GMs Have Crucial Decisions To Make
item.description: The Toronto Maple Leafs and Los Angeles Kings face crucial trade deadline decisions. The Buffalo Sabres' coach, meanwhile, has had quite a turnaround after being on the hot seat earlier this season.

item.title: Patrick Kane Becomes Highest-Scoring U.S.-Born NHL Player
item.description: Detroit Red Wings right winger Patrick Kane breaks Mike Modano's record for the most points by a U.S.-born NHL player on an assist against the Washington Capitals.
